data.title: Some of Meta's safety tools were 'designed to fail': witness
data.description: OAKLAND (UNITED STATES) - A former employee testified on Wednesday that some of Meta's safety tools for Facebook and Instagram were "designed to fail," contradicting the company's defense strategy in a landmark trial in California.

data.title: Ecuador intel chief, five Americans killed in Kenya helicopter crash
data.description: NAIROBI - Ecuador's intelligence chief and five US citizens died when a tourist helicopter crashed in central Kenya on Wednesday, killing all seven people on board, officials said.

data.title: Trump says will meet North Korea's Kim later this year
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US President Donald Trump said Wednesday he would meet North Korean leader Kim Jong Un later this year, in what would be their first encounter of Trump's second term.

data.title: 'Breakthrough' mRNA cancer drug curbs melanoma in large trial
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US drugmakers Merck and Moderna said Wednesday a personalized cancer treatment had shown success in reducing the recurrence of melanoma tumors in a late-stage trial hailed by experts as a "breakthrough."

data.title: Israel army admits firing on car in death of five-year-old Hind Rajab
data.description: JERUSALEM - The Israeli military on Wednesday admitted its troops fired on a car carrying five-year-old Hind Rajab in Gaza in 2024, saying it had ordered a criminal investigation into the killing which drew international outrage.

data.title: Lab-grown human brain cells ‘recorded passage of time’
data.description: PARIS - Peppercorn-sized clumps of human brain cells grown in a laboratory for a record seven years aged similarly to those inside our heads, suggesting they “recorded the passage of time”, scientists said on Wednesday.

data.title: UK media skewered for ‘hounding’ black academic to death
data.description: LONDON - The British press is once again in the spotlight for its methods, this time over accusations that its full-throttle coverage of plagiarism allegations against the Cambridge academic Jason Arday led to his untimely death.

data.title: Ukraine MPs approve new defence minister after divisive reshuffle
data.description: KYIV - Lawmakers approved Ukraine’s new defence minister on Wednesday, a month after a reshuffle that triggered a public backlash after the dismissal of his popular predecessor Mykhailo Fedorov.

data.title: Iran warns Gulf countries against helping US
data.description: TEHRAN - Iran's armed forces warned Gulf countries against assisting the US military on Wednesday, hours after the United Arab Emirates announced it was severing economic ties with Tehran following new attacks on shipping.

data.title: France’s historically hot summer brings 7,300 excess deaths
data.description: PARIS - France has seen more than 7,300 excess deaths during heatwaves so far this year, health authorities said on Wednesday, as the country has also endured a record number of hot days since mid-June, according to an AFP analysis.

data.title: Russia, Ukraine exchange 103 captured soldiers each
data.description: MOSCOW - Russia and Ukraine each handed over 103 captured soldiers on Wednesday, both countries said, in the latest exchange between the warring sides.

data.title: Pre-election violence feared in polarised Israel
data.description: JERUSALEM - Warnings are multiplying that violence could break out between rival political camps ahead of Israel’s election on Oct 27, with powerful figures including top government ministers accused of incitement against opponents.

data.title: Queen Camilla ‘struggled’ to keep husband’s cancer private
data.description: LONDON - Queen Camilla has spoken about the difficulty of not revealing King Charles III had cancer when she visited a support charity shortly after her husband had been diagnosed with the disease.

data.title: Portugal bans full-face veils
data.description: LISBON — Portugal's president has enacted a law pushed by the far right banning the concealment of faces in public, a measure widely seen as targeting Muslim women wearing a full-face veil.

data.title: Pakistani government challenges Imran Khan hospital move
data.description: ISLAMABAD - Pakistan’s ‌government will challenge a Supreme Court decision that ordered authorities to move jailed former prime minister Imran Khan to a private hospital, according to Law Minister Azam Nazeer Tarar.

data.title: Belgian wildfire 'encircled' but situation still 'complicated'
data.description: MALMEDY (BELGIUM) - Firefighters have managed to fully surround Belgium's largest wildfire in a century, but the situation on the ground "remains complicated," authorities said Wednesday.

data.title: Palestinian-American hoists US flag on home besieged by settlers
data.description: QUSRA (PALESTINIAN TERRITORIES) - A Palestinian-American has raised the US flag on his home besieged by Israeli settlers, as the United States renewed criticism of the siege that has generated condemnation around the world.

data.title: Ebola cases in Congo exceed 5,000
data.description: NAIROBI — The number of confirmed Ebola cases ​in the Democratic ‌Republic of Congo (DRC) now exceeds 5,000, government data showed late on Tuesday, as health officials warn that response efforts are ​failing ⁠to contain the deadly disease.

data.title: Nigerian presidential race campaigns kick off
data.description: ABUJA - A campaigning period began Wednesday in Nigeria, five months ahead of elections set to be dominated by crushing inflation and President Bola Tinubu's economic reforms.

data.title: Southern African mothers plead for sons lured to Russia's war
data.description: HARARE (ZIMBABWE) - Instead of celebrating her son's birthday this month, Zimbabwean mother Rodwin Chitewere spent the day praying for his body to be brought home from Russia, where he was reportedly killed fighting Moscow's war against Ukraine.
